parameters.query:
SELECT
    id,
    source,
    tender_id,
    tender_number,
    tender_external_id,
    status,
    tender_meta,
    created_at,
    started_at,
    completed_at
FROM tender_analysis_runs
WHERE id = $1;

SELECT
    field_index,
    field_key,
    status,
    value_text,
    confidence,
    requires_human_review,
    resolution_method,
    result_json
FROM tender_analysis_field_results
WHERE analysis_run_id = $1
ORDER BY field_index;
